title: A panel document, as the engine answers it (PanelDrawing)

group.description: the group's name; empty when it is in none

default.description: Whether there is nothing to write: in no group, free.

Arrangement.description: How a drawn item stands among the others: the group it is chosen and moved with — empty for none —, and its own state. An item is held where it stands when it is locked itself or its group is (holds).

DrawnGroup.description: A group of a drawing as an item of its own: its name, by which its members say they are in it, and its state — a locked group holds every member where it stands, whatever each says of itself.

pcb.description: the pcb it stands, by slug

x.description: where the left of its outline stands, as it stands turned

y.description: where the top of its outline stands

rotation.description: degrees, a quarter turn at a time

across.description: how many copies stand side by side

down.description: how many copies stand one under another

gap.description: between the copies of a grid; empty for the panel's usual

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

PanelDrawing.Board.description: A pcb standing on the panel, once or in a grid.

diameter.description: its copper's diameter, millimetres; empty for the usual

opening.description: the solder mask's opening round it, millimetres; empty for the usual

PanelDrawing.Fiducial.description: A fiducial set by hand: a mark a machine finds the panel by.

rail.description: how wide; empty for the usual

items.description: A side of a panel, as its drawing has it: Y grows downwards, so the top is the smallest Y.

fiducials.description: how many fiducials the frame sets by itself

tooling.description: how many tooling holes the frame sets by itself

drill.description: its diameter, millimetres; empty for the usual

PanelDrawing.Tooling.description: A tooling hole set by hand: a hole a machine holds the panel by.

boards.description: boards, of one pcb or several

frame.description: the rails round them; empty for none

fiducials.description: fiducials set by hand, besides the frame's

tooling.description: tooling holes set by hand, besides the frame's

groups.description: the groups its boards are chosen and moved with, each with its own state

description: A panel as its lines say it: which boards stand where, how they come apart, its frame and what stands on the frame.
